caption.text:
Ada momen haru di balik kemenangan Spanyol atas Argentina di Piala Dunia 2026. Lamine Yamal menghampiri dan memeluk Messi usai pertandingan berakhir dengan skor 1-0 untuk Spanyol.

Momen tersebut sukses mencuri perhatian warganet, di mana dua pemain lintas generasi bisa saling menunjukkan sportivitas.

caption.text_translation:
There's a touching moment behind Spain's victory over Argentina in the 2026 World Cup. Lamine Yamal approached and hugged Messi as the game ended 1-0 for Spain.

The moment successfully stole the attention of the citizens, where two players across generations could show each other sportsmanship.
